image_description: A close-up shot of a person's upper arm and shoulder featuring two adhesive bandages. The top bandage is large, patterned with pink floral designs and black text/graphics, partially peeling at the corner. Below it is a standard beige/tan bandage with a white central pad, also showing signs of wear and slight peeling. The background includes a blurred figure in a red shirt and blue sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible bandages fit the size description relative to the human arm anatomy.
The bottom bandage clearly exhibits the standard narrow rectangular shape with rounded ends. The top one is wider but still rectangular with rounded corners.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black text/graphic elements on the upper bandage appear distorted and nonsensical upon close inspection, typical of AI-generated text rendering issues. Characters merge and lack linguistic structure.
Slight blurring and 'melting' where the adhesive wing meets the skin, lacking the sharp, crisp edge expected of real adhesive tape.
The peeling corner on the left side of the upper bandage lacks physical thickness and seems to blend into the background rather than casting a shadow or showing a distinct underside.
